stemBlocks.value: Think first: Every term in the first bracket must multiply every term in the second — four products in all.

stemBlocks.altText: Source visual for edmar-csec-p052-q01 from workbook page 52.

solutionSteps.instruction: Multiply the first terms of each bracket.
Multiply the outer and inner pairs.

strategyBlocks.value: Multiply out using FOIL, then add the two middle terms.

whyThisWorks.value: Expanding uses the distributive law twice: (x + 5)(x + 7) means x(x + 7) + 5(x + 7). Every term of one bracket must reach every term of the other, which is why there are exactly four products. The x-coefficient in the answer is the sum of the two numbers and the constant is their product, a pattern worth remembering for factorising later.

examTip.value: For (x + a)(x + b) the answer is always x² + (a + b)x + ab. Use it as a fast check on the expansion you just wrote out.
